title: To Align Long, Plan Short: Simulating Diverse Profile-Aligned Students by Realizing Short-Term Plans in Long-Horizon Learning Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.02002v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulated students offer a scalable way to test learning platforms and AI tutors before deployment with real students and to augment scarce data for studying learning at scale. Existing LLM-based simulators primarily target short, language-centered interactions. In open-ended learning environments, however, student behavior emerges from patterns across long-horizon interaction trajectories, where turn-level prompting can drift from an assigned behavior profile. We introduce ALPS (Align Long-term by Planning Short-term), a hierarchical simulated student conditioned on observable, environment-specific behavior profiles. Rather than selecting every action independently, ALPS alternates between planning profile-aligned task segments and generating the corresponding actions. translated_title: 长期对齐，短期规划：通过在长时程学习环境中实现短期计划来模拟多样化的符合画像的学生
translated_abstract: 模拟学生提供了一种可扩展的方式，可以在真实学生部署之前测试学习平台和AI导师，并能扩充稀缺数据以研究大规模学习。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的模拟器主要针对短的、以语言为中心的交互。然而，在开放式学习环境中，学生行为产生于长时程交互轨迹中的模式，在这种情况下，轮次级别的提示可能会偏离指定的行为画像。我们提出了ALPS（通过短期规划实现长期对齐），这是一种以可观察的、环境特定的行为画像为条件的分层模拟学生。ALPS不是独立地选择每一个动作，而是交替进行画像对齐的任务片段规划和相应动作的生成。我们在数据充足和数据稀缺的两种设置中评估了ALPS，其中监督信号既可以来自真实的学生轨迹，也可以来自教师LLM。在两种设置中
tldr: 提出了ALPS分层模拟学生框架，通过交替进行“画像对齐的任务片段规划”和“动作生成”，使模拟学生在长时程开放式学习环境中持续符合指定的行为画像。
en_tdlr: ALPS introduces a hierarchical simulated student that alternates between planning profile-aligned task segments and generating corresponding actions, maintaining long-horizon alignment with specified behavior profiles in open-ended learning environments.
